goal: Drive AKS RP e2e feature knowledge, runnable test specs, replay execution, evidence diagnosis, and model feedback.
strategy: Learn feature intent from Go e2ev3 source, API/spec, user docs, design notes, implementation references, and existing evidence.
Ground each feature with a reference packet so pass/fail judgment has a source-of-truth bundle.
Generate runnable REST-first test specs and TypeScript replays in the domain project.
Execute specs through the domain runner when gated, then feed verdict-driving evidence back into the model.
Plan and run combined-scenario suites so compatible specs share CRUD lifecycles, save AKS capacity, and expose dependency bugs.
Continuously reconcile Go e2ev3 source coverage, including suite-condition variants, and tidy feature/spec/model structure so the knowledge base stays canonical.
